name: autoexec_combop
label: Tool Information Table
description: The tool information table can be used for enabling state filtering, time dimension statistics, and query association in report scenarios related to automation.

fields.name: id
fields.description: If from the tool/script, the combop is directly generated, use the corresponding ID. Otherwise, the ID is automatically generated, used as the primary key or unique identifier for records in this table.

fields.name: name
fields.description: Name. This value must be unique in the database and is suitable for exact-match queries and duplicate detection.

indexes.name: PRIMARY
indexes.description: Primary key index covering the ID field, suitable for uniquely identifying records and queries that join the primary table.

indexes.name: uniq_name
indexes.description: Unique index covering the name field, suitable for exact-match retrieval, uniqueness checks, and duplicate detection.
